# `aitbc analytics summary`

Get a performance summary for one chain or a cross-chain analysis.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc analytics summary [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Specific chain ID to analyze |
| `--hours` | integer | `24` | no | Time range in hours |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc analytics summary
```
